components.description:
EventCalendar is a day / week / month / agenda calendar for displaying and
editing events, wrapping the MUI X `EventCalendar` (Community, MIT). Events
cross the Dash boundary as plain dicts with ISO-string dates; user edits
(create / move / resize / delete) round-trip back through the `events` prop.
components.name: EventCalendar

props.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.
props.name: id

props.description: Allow drag-to-reschedule. Default true.
props.name: areEventsDraggable

props.description: Allow resize (bool, or restrict to "start"/"end"). Default true.
props.name: areEventsResizable

props.description: Allow external events to be dragged in. Default false.
props.name: canDragEventsFromTheOutside

props.description: Allow events to be dragged out of the calendar. Default false.
props.name: canDropEventsToTheOutside

props.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.
props.name: className

props.description: Uncontrolled initial preferences (same shape as `preferences`).
props.name: defaultPreferences

props.description: Uncontrolled initial view. Default "week".
props.name: defaultView

props.description: Uncontrolled initial visible date (ISO string). Default today.
props.name: defaultVisibleDate

props.description: Uncontrolled initial resource visibility map. Default {} (all visible).
props.name: defaultVisibleResources

props.description:
Timezone used to render events: an IANA name
("America/New_York"), or "default" / "locale" / "UTC". Render-only —
events keep their own data timezone. Default "default".
props.name: displayTimezone

props.description:
The default color palette used for all events. Overridden per resource
(`eventColor`) and per event (`color`). Default "teal".
props.name: eventColor

props.description:
Configures event creation. `false` disables it; `true` enables it with
defaults; an object sets the interaction and default duration (minutes).
props.name: eventCreation

props.description:
On desktop, inset the event drawer this many px from the top — e.g. set
it to your fixed app header's height so the drawer lines up with a
sidebar instead of covering the header. Default 0.
props.name: eventDialogTopOffset

props.description:
How the event editor is presented. "drawer" (default) restyles the
built-in dialog into a responsive drawer — right-anchored on desktop, an
80%-height bottom sheet on mobile (below `mobileBreakpoint`), with a
scrollable body and pinned header/actions. "dialog" keeps the library's
default floating, draggable dialog.
props.name: eventDialogVariant

props.description:
The events to render. Each event is a dict with at least `id`, `title`,
`start` and `end` (ISO strings). This is BOTH an input and an output:
the calendar writes the full array back on every create / edit / move /
resize / delete.
props.name: events

props.description: Height of the wrapping container (the calendar fills it). Default 600.
props.name: height

props.description:
Convenience OUTPUT describing the most recent change to `events`:
{type: "create"|"update"|"delete"|"move"|"resize"|"change",
 event: the affected event (or null), event_timestamp}.
props.name: lastAction

props.description: Override UI label strings (a partial map of translation keys).
props.name: localeText

props.description: Width (px) below which the UI switches to its mobile layout. Default 768.
props.name: mobileBreakpoint

props.description:
Controlled user preferences. Also an OUTPUT.
{ampm, weekStartsOn (0=Sun..6=Sat), showWeekends, showWeekNumber,
 isSidePanelOpen, showEmptyDaysInAgenda}.
props.name: preferences

props.description: Which items appear in the preferences menu, or `false` to hide the menu.
props.name: preferencesMenuConfig

props.description: Global read-only mode (disables create / drag / resize / dialog).
props.name: readOnly

props.description: Resources events can be assigned to (supports nested `children`).
props.name: resources

props.description:
When true (default), the side panel starts open on wide screens and
collapsed below `mobileBreakpoint` on first render — unless you pin
`isSidePanelOpen` via `preferences` / `defaultPreferences`.
props.name: responsiveSidePanel

props.description:
In the day / week views, scroll the time grid on first render (and on
view change) so the current-time indicator is centered in view. Pairs
with `showCurrentTimeIndicator`. Default false.
props.name: scrollToCurrentTime

props.description: Require every event to be assigned to a resource. Default false.
props.name: shouldEventRequireResource

props.description: Show the current-time indicator line in time views. Default true.
props.name: showCurrentTimeIndicator

props.description: MUI `sx` styling object applied to the calendar (object form only).
props.name: sx

props.description: Controlled active view. Also an OUTPUT (updated on view change).
props.name: view

props.description: Which views are offered. Default ["day","week","month","agenda"].
props.name: views

props.description:
Controlled visible date (ISO string). Drives which date range is shown.
Also an OUTPUT — written back (ISO string) when the user navigates.
props.name: visibleDate

props.description: Controlled resource visibility map {resourceId: bool}. Also an OUTPUT.
props.name: visibleResources

components.description:
EventCalendarPremium is the Event Calendar with the MUI X Premium recurrence
engine: events can carry an `rrule` (RFC-5545 string or object) and
`exDates`, and the edit dialog gains a Recurrence tab. Requires a MUI X
Premium license key (the `licenseKey` prop) to render without a watermark.

components.description:
EventTimeline is a resource-row, Gantt-style timeline that places events on
the row of the resource they are assigned to, across configurable zoom
presets, wrapping the MUI X `EventTimelinePremium`. Requires a MUI X Premium
license key (the `licenseKey` prop) to render without a watermark.
components.name: EventTimeline

props.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.
props.name: id

props.description: Allow drag-to-reschedule allocations. Default true.
props.name: areEventsDraggable

props.description: Allow resize (bool, or restrict to "start"/"end"). Default true.
props.name: areEventsResizable

props.description: Allow external events to be dragged in. Default false.
props.name: canDragEventsFromTheOutside

props.description: Allow events to be dragged out of the timeline. Default false.
props.name: canDropEventsToTheOutside

props.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.
props.name: className

props.description: Uncontrolled initial preferences {ampm, weekStartsOn}. Default {ampm: true}.
props.name: defaultPreferences

props.description: Uncontrolled initial preset. Default "dayAndHour".
props.name: defaultPreset

props.description: Uncontrolled initial visible date (ISO string). Default today.
props.name: defaultVisibleDate

props.description: Uncontrolled initial resource visibility map. Default {} (all visible).
props.name: defaultVisibleResources

props.description: Render timezone: IANA name, or "default"/"locale"/"UTC". Default "default".
props.name: displayTimezone

props.description: Default color palette for all events (overridable). Default "teal".
props.name: eventColor

props.description:
Configures event creation. `false` disables it; `true` enables defaults;
an object sets {interaction, duration (minutes)}.
props.name: eventCreation

props.description:
On desktop, inset the event drawer this many px from the top — e.g. set
it to your fixed app header's height. Default 0.
props.name: eventDialogTopOffset

props.description:
How the event editor is presented. "drawer" (default) restyles the
built-in dialog into a responsive frosted-glass drawer — right-anchored
on desktop, an 88%-height bottom sheet on mobile (below
`mobileBreakpoint`). "dialog" keeps the library's floating dialog.
props.name: eventDialogVariant

props.description:
Allocation bars. Each event needs `id`, `title`, `start`, `end` (ISO
strings) and usually a `resource` (the row it sits on). INPUT + OUTPUT.
props.name: events

props.description: Height of the wrapping container (the timeline fills it). Default 400.
props.name: height

props.description: Convenience OUTPUT describing the most recent change to `events`.
props.name: lastAction

props.description: MUI X Premium license key (removes the watermark).
props.name: licenseKey

props.description: Override UI label strings (a partial map of translation keys).
props.name: localeText

props.description: Width (px) below which the editor uses its mobile layout. Default 768.
props.name: mobileBreakpoint

props.description: Controlled preferences {ampm, weekStartsOn}. Also an OUTPUT.
props.name: preferences

props.description:
Controlled zoom preset. Also an OUTPUT. One of
"dayAndHour" | "dayAndMonth" | "dayAndWeek" | "monthAndYear" | "year".
props.name: preset

props.description:
The presets available (zoom levels offered). Default is all five, from
most zoomed-in to most zoomed-out.
props.name: presets

props.description: Global read-only mode.
props.name: readOnly

props.description: Label shown in the resource column header.
props.name: resourceColumnLabel

props.description: The resource rows. Each event's `resource` points to one of these ids.
props.name: resources

props.description: Require every event to be assigned to a resource. Default true (timeline).
props.name: shouldEventRequireResource

props.description: Show the current-time indicator line. Default true.
props.name: showCurrentTimeIndicator

props.description: MUI `sx` styling object applied to the timeline (object form only).
props.name: sx

props.description: Controlled visible date (ISO string) — centers the window. Also OUTPUT.
props.name: visibleDate

props.description: Controlled resource visibility map {resourceId: bool}. Also an OUTPUT.
props.name: visibleResources

components.description:
RadialBarChart compares values along periodic categories using polar bars.
Series accept `stack` and `layout` ("vertical" = radius encodes the value,
"horizontal" = rotation encodes it); the band rotation axis accepts
`categoryGapRatio` / `barGapRatio`. Clicking reports the hit item via the
`clickData` output. Premium (preview) — set `licenseKey`.
components.name: RadialBarChart

props.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.
props.name: id

props.description:
Axis highlight behavior: {rotation, radius} where each is one of
"none" | "line" | "band". Default depends on the layout.
props.name: axisHighlight

props.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.
props.name: className

props.description:
OUTPUT — set when the user clicks the chart. The clicked axis item and
its series values, e.g. {dataIndex, axisValue, seriesValues, event_timestamp}.
props.name: clickData

props.description: Color palette (list of CSS colors) used for the series.
props.name: colors

props.description: Row-oriented data; series reference columns via `dataKey`.
props.name: dataset

props.description: Show background grid lines: {rotation: bool, radius: bool}.
props.name: grid

props.description: Chart height in px. Default 400.
props.name: height

props.description: Hide the legend.
props.name: hideLegend

props.description: MUI X Premium license key (removes the watermark).
props.name: licenseKey

props.description: Margin around the plot — a number or {top,right,bottom,left}.
props.name: margin

props.description: Radius axis config — replaces the cartesian y-axis. A list of axis dicts.
props.name: radiusAxis

props.description:
Rotation (angular) axis config — replaces the cartesian x-axis. A list of
axis dicts. A band axis accepts `categoryGapRatio` / `barGapRatio`, e.g.
[{scaleType:"band", data:["2020","2021"], categoryGapRatio:0.3, barGapRatio:0.1}].
props.name: rotationAxis

props.description:
The bar series to plot. Each item is a dict, e.g.
{dataKey, label, stack, layout:"vertical"|"horizontal", color} or
{data: [...], label, ...}.
props.name: series

props.description: Show the default chart toolbar.
props.name: showToolbar

props.description: Skip the entrance animation.
props.name: skipAnimation

props.description: MUI X charts `slotProps` (plain-object form only), e.g. {"tooltip": {"trigger": "item"}}.
props.name: slotProps

props.description: MUI `sx` styling object (object form only).
props.name: sx

props.description: Chart width in px (defaults to filling the container).
props.name: width

components.description:
RadialLineChart shows trends along periodic values using a polar line (or
area) plot. Pass `series` plus `rotationAxis` / `radiusAxis` to map your data
into polar coordinates; clicking the chart reports the hit axis item via the
`clickData` output. Premium (preview) — set `licenseKey` to remove the
watermark.
components.name: RadialLineChart

props.description: The id used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.
props.name: id

props.description:
Axis highlight behavior: {rotation, radius} where each is one of
"none" | "line" | "band". Default {rotation: "line"}.
props.name: axisHighlight

props.description: CSS class applied to the wrapping div.
props.name: className

props.description:
OUTPUT — set when the user clicks the chart. The clicked rotation-axis
item and its series values, e.g.
{dataIndex, axisValue, seriesValues, event_timestamp}.
props.name: clickData

props.description: Color palette (list of CSS colors) used for the series.
props.name: colors

props.description: Row-oriented data; series reference columns via `dataKey`.
props.name: dataset

props.description: Disable the per-item line highlight indicator.
props.name: disableLineItemHighlight

props.description: Show background grid lines: {rotation: bool, radius: bool}.
props.name: grid

props.description: Chart height in px. Default 400.
props.name: height

props.description: Hide the legend.
props.name: hideLegend

props.description: MUI X Premium license key (removes the watermark).
props.name: licenseKey

props.description: Margin around the plot — a number or {top,right,bottom,left}.
props.name: margin

props.description:
Radius axis config — replaces the cartesian y-axis. A list of axis dicts,
e.g. [{disableLine:true, minRadius:10, min:0, position:"none"}].
props.name: radiusAxis

props.description:
Rotation (angular) axis config — replaces the cartesian x-axis. A list of
axis dicts, e.g. [{scaleType:"point", dataKey:"month", disableLine:true}].
props.name: rotationAxis

props.description:
The line/area series to plot. Each item is a dict, e.g.
{dataKey, label, curve, showMark, shape, area, closePath, stack,
 highlightScope, color} or {data: [...], label, ...}.
props.name: series

props.description: Show the default chart toolbar.
props.name: showToolbar

props.description: Skip the entrance animation.
props.name: skipAnimation

props.description:
MUI X charts `slotProps` (plain-object form only). For example
{"tooltip": {"trigger": "item"}} makes the tooltip follow the hovered
mark/line instead of the whole rotation axis.
props.name: slotProps

props.description: MUI `sx` styling object (object form only).
props.name: sx

props.description: Chart width in px (defaults to filling the container).
props.name: width
